title: Greedy vs Hungarian + capacity repair vs RL (MaskablePPO) on P03 fleet subsets
notes: Common event tape is the primary mode: for each (N, seed) the initial catalog, arrivals, and outages are identical for every method; the tape hash is stored per episode.
The tape's pool cap uses a virtual queue in which offered jobs never complete, and outages may hit any satellite; native mode instead caps on the live queue and spares busy satellites.
Native mode shares seeds and parameters only: later arrivals and outages depend on each policy's decisions, so it is not a comparison on an identical job set.
Hungarian + capacity repair solves a one-tick assignment. It is not a whole-shift planner, and with the repair it is not an exact solution of the capped one-tick problem.
Greedy reads env.downlink_limit on every tick after reset (n_sats // 8), not the scenario's initial value.
Primary RL mode is RL_stochastic, fixed before the run. The other mode is supplementary.
RL was trained on 48 satellites; N < 48 is zero-shot transfer, so a drop there may come from the shifted observation distribution.
Only 3 seeds: all tables and plots are preliminary.

metric_definitions.completed: completed_step is set and completed_step <= deadline_step
metric_definitions.due: deadline_step <= env.k at shift end (the denominator of every completion and miss rate, per kind)
metric_definitions.pending_with_future_deadline: not completed and deadline_step > env.k (never counted as missed)
metric_definitions.revenue_usd: sum of simulator value_usd over completed jobs; no PRICE_DIV rescaling
metric_definitions.revenue_per_completed_job: revenue_usd / completed_total; null when nothing completed
metric_definitions.q_selection: mean value of completed jobs / mean value of due jobs, per kind
metric_definitions.decision_ms: wall time of the method call only (no env.step, no observation); first tick excluded as warm-up
metric_definitions.ci95: t-interval of the mean over seeds; paired deltas use a percentile bootstrap over seeds

hungarian.label: Hungarian + capacity repair
hungarian.weight: w_ij = value_usd_j / T_ij + 1e-4 * soc_i + 1e-3 * [i executed j last tick]
hungarian.T_ij: relay: remaining_steps; downlink: remaining_steps for the current holder, else work_steps
hungarian.idle_columns: one zero-weight idle column per satellite; only pairs with w > 0 and mask = 1 can be chosen
hungarian.capacity_repair: keep the downlink_limit heaviest downlinks, then rerun the assignment for every other satellite over relay slots
hungarian.calibration: idle satellites calibrate when allowed and calibration age >= 0.85 of validity (greedy rule)

timing.method: time.perf_counter around the method call; RL includes tensor conversion and decoding, Hungarian includes building its tick view
timing.warmup: the first decision of each shift is excluded and stored as decision_ms_first
